verses.text: Ay jun winh skuchan Pasur yuninal winhaj Imer, sat sacerdote yaj winh t'a stemplo Jehová. Ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix wal a in Jeremías in tik,
ix in schekan mak'jok winh, ix in schekan ak'jokpaxoch winh t'a te' cepo t'a spuerta'il templo t'a stojolal smakb'en Benjamín.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, a winh ix halani to tzin ik'chajel t'a yol te' cepo chi'. Yuj chi' ix walan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová ix k'exan a b'i. Magor-misabib ol a b'i'ejkani, syalelk'ochi xiwk'olalnhej yaji.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'och xiwk'olal t'a ib'anh yet' masanil heb' wach' ak'an yet'ok. K'elan ach wal ochi ol miljokcham heb' a wach'k'o'ol yuj yespada heb' ajk'o'ol. Ha exxo aj Judá ex tik ol ex wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia. Ay ex ol ex yik'b'at winh t'a Babilonia chi', ayex pax ol ex smilcham winh.
Masanil he b'eyumal yet' masanil tastak ay stojol ay t'ayex yet' sb'eyumal heb' sreyal Judá ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi', ol yik'anb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha hachxo tik ach Pasur, ol ach ik'chajb'at chekab'ok t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan et' t'a a pat. Hata' ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchajkan ta' yet' heb' a wach'k'o'ol chi', haton heb' b'aj ix esejkanel in ti'ok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, tonhej ix in a montej. Ix in k'anab'ajan tas ix ala'. Yelxo te tek'an ach, yuj chi' ix in ak' ganar. Masanil tiempo tzin tzetzaji, masanil anima tzin b'uchan u'uj.

Ayik swalan t'a heb' juntak el icha tik: Ol jawok yahelal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex lajwokelok, xin chinhej t'a heb'. Yuj chi' aynhejoch heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'ayin, tzin sb'uchan pax heb', yujto swalel a lolonel.

Tato swala' to maxtzak ach wak' b'inajok, maxtzak walpaxel a lolonel, haxo tz'aji, icha te' k'ak' tz'aj a lolonel chi' t'ayin. Stz'ab'at in b'akil yuj swab'i. Tzin nib'ej tzin och wa'an walanel a lolonel tik, palta maxtzak yal-laj.

Swab' wal sajson heb' in sb'uchani: Syalan heb' icha tik: Ina winh xiwk'olalnhej yaj tik, xchi heb'. Syalanpax heb': Koyek, b'at kik'ekcha'anh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh winh, xchi heb'. Hanhejtona' heb' in wach'k'o'ol, snib'ej heb' b'aj tzin lektaji. Syalan heb' wu'uj icha tik: Ko sayek modo tas tz'aj kak'an ganar kak'anek ek' ko pak t'a winh, xchi heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ayachnhej ek' wet'ok, icha junok soldado malaj mach tz'ak'an ganar. Ha heb' tzin pechani ol ak'jok ganar heb', a inxo jun manh ol in yak' ganar heb'. Ol k'ixwokkanel heb', manh ol satlaj sk'ol heb' t'a sk'ixwelal chi'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, a ach tza ch'olb'itej heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, tzilan tastak sna heb' anima. Ch'ox wil tas ol utej ak'an syahelal juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wak'och in b'a ab'enal t'a yol a k'ab'.
B'itejek Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay. Ha skolanel heb' tz'ab'an sya'il t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
Te chuk jun k'u b'aj aljinak in. Mokab' alchaj wach'il t'a jun k'u b'aj aljinak in t'a in nun.
Ob'iltak jun winak xit' alannak t'a winh in mam to ix alji jun yuninal winh yik stzalaj winh.
Satokab'el jun winak chi', icha juntzanh chonhab' ix satji'el yuj Dios t'a junelnhej. Yab'okab' winh yel aw yuj yahelal t'a k'inhib'alil yet' aw yik ak'oj owal t'a chimk'uhalil.
¿Tas yuj maj in mak'jicham yuj jun winak chi' ayik manto in alji? Tato icha chi', kannhejnak in am t'a ix in nun chi', ichato t'a ix mukchajnak in kani.
¿Tas wal yuj aljinak in? ¿Tom yuj wilan syahelal, yik tzin cham t'a k'ixwelal? xin chi.
